investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Cedarpine Assurance (insurance); Platform: Microsoft Azure northeurope (zones northeurope-1/northeurope-2/northeurope-3); network range 10.98.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster cedarp-prod-northe (AKS); Edge tier: agent-portal proxies API calls to backend services using per-upstream timeouts from its configuration file; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
